name: Fidelity Denim
why: A teenager gilding jeans in a Vancouver basement, grown into one of LA's last cut-sew-wash denim houses — Candiani Italian fabric, ultra-soft stretch, deliberately untrendy fits.
origin: Jason Trotzuk — a Vancouver teenager gilding old jeans in his parents' basement, 2005; moved the family to LA to live beside the wash house.
opview: Trotzuk's stated creed: fabric, fit, and finish — and jeans worth moving your family for.

notes.denim: cut, sewn, and washed in LA on custom cloth from Italy's Candiani mill — rare among LA denim brands, most of which never name their fabric source
notes.comfort: ultra-soft washed stretch as the founding signature
notes.ital: the Candiani connection — Italian cloth in a Vancouver-to-LA story

cities: Specialty clothiers via showroom wholesale · online · made in Los Angeles
